diagnosis_basis: 201 overlapping fill records, 83 unique opportunities; passive shared-fill gain +0.787935 offset by nine missed V4 fills +3.003323; structural-only buffered VWAP failure lies beyond original stop for32/40 continuation fills; relaxed eligibility/ranking confounded; no rule below selected by a new native PnL search.

H1_ENTRY_ACCESS.mechanism: Waiting for a retracement can improve price but miss directional expansion. Expiry and entry choice must be separated.
H1_ENTRY_ACCESS.conditional_rule: Continuation only: immediate original reference if directional signal body >=0.8 original ATR AND original15m rvol>=1.2; otherwise passive0.15 original ATR with original5min configured expiry. Reversals retain immediate original V4 reference. Reuse existing displacement and volume constants; no fitted threshold.
H1_ENTRY_ACCESS.expiry_ablation: Unconditional original passive0.15ATR reference, same trigger/stop/target; extend expiry to30minutes, exactly two15m bars. No chasing; native pending-order invalidation and legal risk remain.
H1_ENTRY_ACCESS.control: Frozen V4 and PR13 passive plans
H1_ENTRY_ACCESS.falsification: Does not improve net expectancy per original56 opportunities, loses under native extra10bp/side, relies on one winner, or finer-resolution fills reverse the apparent gain. Full-development gains alone are insufficient.

H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.mechanism: Separate raw EMA eligibility from hourly EMA shortlist authority and test whether rank slots should be occupied by presently qualified signals.
H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.eligibility_rule: Remove only three EMA alignment/slope predicates from frozen continuation raw mask. Retain all non-EMA predicates, original structure_reason (including its local FVG alternative), geometry and liquidity. Do not add PR13's mandatory hourly-structure condition.
H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.ranking_rule: Same V4 score, stable pair tie-break, three per playbook/side. Relaxed-rank arm removes only hourly EMA pool veto. Qualified-rank arm keeps strict signals and ranks only currently qualified, liquid signal candidates.
H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.control: Frozen V4 strict eligibility/strict ranking; compare original PR13 relaxed separately to disclose its additional structure requirement
H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.diagnostic_ablation: Continuation-only V4 is explicitly selected after the known playbook results; test natively but do not call it independently discovered or validated.
H2_SELECTION_AUTHORITY.falsification: Ranking/eligibility correction lowers opportunity expectancy, excludes higher-quality signals, has unstable market/chronological effects, or survives only optimistic costs. Additional fills are not success.

H3_THESIS_COMPATIBILITY.mechanism: A buffered frozen-zone thesis boundary beyond the original protective stop cannot provide earlier failure detection.
H3_THESIS_COMPATIBILITY.rule: Use original structural-only exit only if directional distance from buffered boundary (boundary - side*0.15 signalATR) to original stop is strictly greater than one native price tick. Otherwise retain frozen V4 fast EMA/VWAP thesis exit. Classify compatibility once from immutable entry geometry. Same entries, stop, target and hold. No stop widening, trailing addition or reverse position.
H3_THESIS_COMPATIBILITY.control: Frozen V4 and PR13 structural-only portfolio
H3_THESIS_COMPATIBILITY.falsification: Compatible fallback fails to recover structural-only loss or underperforms V4; compatibility repair does not by itself imply economic superiority.
